build: release, no default features, mimalloc; production allocator aliases audited
scope: Genuine ordinary-Calc CAST/TRY_CAST of proven unbounded integer STRING text into DECIMAL(p,s) whose integral capacity covers the complete resolved signed integer width. Source STRING, bounded text, insufficient capacity, unverified producers and UNNEST retain preceding routes.
released_contract: Integer text is ASCII with no extra leading zero, point or exponent. With target p-s >= 3/5/10/19 for the resolved TINYINT/SMALLINT/INT/BIGINT width, both released byte and BigDecimal parsing give exact integer times 10^s without overflow. Retain NULLs and resolved result schema. General STRING/DECIMAL text is not covered by this proof.

method.input: Equivalent prepared GenericRowData/BinaryRowData and Arrow over all four signed widths, each at scales 0, 3 and 38-widthDigits, target precision widthDigits+scale, both NULL modes and signed minimum/extreme values. Both engines evaluate TRY_CAST(CAST(value AS STRING) AS target) >= CAST(0 AS target). Full output values/schema are verified separately in SQL.
method.native_timer: Rust after setup/import and before export. Production Calc, allocation, exact decimal scaling and the common comparison/output consumption remain timed; stock and actual previous retain their integer formatting and released parser. Only this small-function gate excludes perimeter JNI/C Data and transposes.
method.previous: Actual preceding encoder and release runtime; generated evaluator inside NativeCalc, NOT host fallback. Matched fixture bytecode, independent stock controls in both processes; previous/candidate process order reversed on 1.18.
method.pipeline: Six configurations, million-row external Row source and blackhole sink, two warmups/five alternating measurements per engine. Retain submission/startup/JNI and both perimeter transposes. Candidate requires consumed NativeCalc and empty evaluators; previous requires its actual generated evaluator.

initial_route_probe.failed_control: The ordinary CAST roundtrip is already simplified by Flink to a direct numeric cast in this context. The previous pure route correctly rejects the generated-evaluator expectation. Retain fifty unpaired candidate samples as an already-native control, not as a new-feature speedup. Final measurements use actual TRY_CAST producers instead.

released_stock_oracles_scope: Fresh unchanged released CastRulesTest stock-only execution on both lines/JDKs. The 1.18 released table-common tests artifact supplies TableAssertions; an initial missing-class run is excluded from correctness counts. SQL/native work is qualified separately.

before_observation: Each of eight positive invocations per Flink/JDK pair compares complete first-query 5003-row map/schema before expected pure-route failure. Two retained controls pass. Subsequent unreached SQL is not before-parity evidence.
algorithm_oracle_scope: 243968 released utility comparisons across all fitting target precision/scale combinations and all signed widths on both release/JDK pairs. Algorithm evidence only; separate SQL and route evidence is required.
limitations: Prepared bulk gains do not establish tiny-batch or conversion-inclusive job gains.
Retain all tiny and complete-job losses, variability and independent stock results.

The feature does not implement arbitrary source STRING parsing, bounded text, targets lacking complete signed-width capacity, or unverified/fallible producers. Some ordinary CAST roundtrips are already planner-simplified; their previous route is not relabeled as generated.
Historical experiments/partial tests on preceding classpaths are not relabeled as final full-core qualification.
Hosted CI must qualify the exact final PR head separately.
